content: RDS must be in same VPC as ECS Fargate tasks for private connectivity; RDS security group inbound rule allows TCP/5432 from the ECS task security group (SG-to-SG reference, not CIDR). RDS should sit in private subnets with no public accessibility; Fargate tasks in private subnets reach RDS via VPC-internal DNS resolution of the RDS endpoint. Most connectivity issues trace back to security group misconfiguration.
